blocks.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: DotGrey Digital (“DotGrey”, “we”, “us”) is a design and engineering studio based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, working with clients worldwide. This policy explains what personal information we handle when you use dotgreydigital.com or contact us, and what you can ask us to do with it.
For anything in this policy, write to hello@dotgreydigital.com.

blocks.heading: What we collect
paragraphs: We mostly collect what you choose to send us. This site has no accounts and no advertising tags. If you accept analytics, we also measure how the site is used (see Analytics below).
bullets: What you send through the contact form, the Start a project steps and the job application form: your name, email address, company, what you need, budget, timing, links and message. The form emails it to the studio inbox through our email delivery provider (Resend) or our web host's mail server. This website does not keep a copy in a database. If the form can't send, it opens your own email app instead. To block spam, the form server remembers how many messages came from your IP address in the last ten minutes, and nothing longer.
The email address you give us when you sign up for occasional notes. It is added to our mailing list at Resend, or emailed to us so we can add it by hand.
Job applications, through the form or by email: your CV or portfolio links and anything else you include.
Preference cookies that remember your colour mode, your accent colour and your answer to the analytics question, and, only if you accept analytics, Google's analytics cookies (see Cookies below).

blocks.heading: How we use it
paragraphs: We use your information to reply to you, scope and deliver work you ask us for, send the newsletter you requested, and consider job applications. We do not sell personal information, and we do not use it for advertising or automated profiling.

blocks.heading: Legal basis
paragraphs: Where data protection law asks for a legal basis, we rely on your request (to answer you or prepare a proposal), on a contract (to deliver an engagement), on consent (for the newsletter and for analytics cookies, which you can withdraw at any time), and on our legitimate interest in running the studio and keeping basic business records.

blocks.heading: Cookies
paragraphs: First-party cookies: dg-theme remembers light or dark mode, dg-accent remembers an accent colour, and, when analytics is switched on for the site, dg-consent remembers whether you accepted or declined it. They contain no identifier, are not shared with anyone and expire after a year.

Only if you accept analytics, Google Analytics sets _ga and _ga_<ID> (identifiers that tell browsers apart and keep the state of a visit, lasting up to two years). If you decline, or ignore the banner, Google's script is not even loaded and these cookies are not set.

You can change your mind at any time with Cookie settings in the footer (or on the Cookies page); choosing Decline stops analytics immediately and deletes Google's cookies. You can also clear every cookie in your browser. A browser that sends Global Privacy Control or Do Not Track is treated as having declined.

blocks.heading: Analytics
paragraphs: When analytics is switched on for this site, and only if you accept it in the cookie banner, we use Google Analytics 4 to understand which pages are read and which links are used, so we can improve the site. It collects page views, the pages and links you use, your browser and device type, the language, your approximate location (country or city, worked out from your IP address, which Google truncates), and how you arrived. It does not receive your name, email address or anything you type into our forms.

We have switched off Google's advertising features and signals, so the data is not used for advertising or profiling. Google acts as our processor. The data is stored for 14 months and then deleted, and may be processed in countries outside Bangladesh and outside your own (see International transfers). To withdraw consent, use Cookie settings in the footer and choose Decline.

blocks.heading: Who we share it with
paragraphs: We share personal information only with services we use to run the studio, and only as much as each needs:
bullets: Our email and document providers, which store our correspondence, and Resend, which delivers form submissions and newsletter emails on our behalf.

Our web host (Vercel, or a standard web hosting provider), which serves this website, may deliver form emails through its mail server, and keeps standard server logs (such as IP address and request time) for security and reliability.
Google, which provides Google Analytics, only if you accept analytics. Google processes that data on our behalf.
Professional advisers such as accountants and lawyers, where required.
Authorities, where the law requires it.

blocks.heading: International transfers
paragraphs: We work with clients and providers in several countries, so your information may be processed outside Bangladesh or outside your own country. Where that happens we use reputable providers and, where the law requires it, appropriate safeguards such as standard contractual clauses.

blocks.heading: How long we keep it
paragraphs: We keep enquiries that do not lead to work for up to two years, then delete them. Client correspondence and project records are kept for as long as the engagement lasts and for up to seven years afterwards, for legal and accounting reasons. Job applications are kept for up to one year unless you ask us to delete them sooner. Newsletter addresses are kept until you unsubscribe. Analytics data is kept in Google Analytics for 14 months.

blocks.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to:
bullets: ask for a copy of the personal information we hold about you;
ask us to correct or delete it;
object to or restrict how we use it;
withdraw consent you have given, such as for the newsletter or analytics;
complain to your local data protection authority.

blocks.heading: Security
paragraphs: We use providers with strong security practices, keep access to client information to the people working on that engagement, and use two-factor authentication on our accounts. No system is perfectly secure; if we become aware of a breach that affects you, we will tell you promptly.

blocks.heading: Children
paragraphs: This site is meant for businesses and is not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 16.

blocks.heading: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: If we change how we handle personal information, we will update this page and the date at the top. Significant changes will be highlighted here.

blocks.heading: Contact

blocks.heading: About these terms
paragraphs: These terms apply to your use of dotgreydigital.com (the “site”), operated by DotGrey Digital, Dhaka, Bangladesh. By using the site you agree to them. If you do not agree, please do not use the site.

blocks.heading: Using the site
paragraphs: You may browse, read and share links to the site for any lawful purpose. Please do not:
bullets: copy, scrape or republish substantial parts of the site without permission;
try to break, overload or gain unauthorised access to the site or its hosting;
use the site to send spam or anything unlawful.

blocks.heading: Our content
paragraphs: The text, design, illustrations and code of this site belong to DotGrey Digital unless stated otherwise. Project names and trademarks belong to their owners and are shown to describe work we did with them. Some project visuals are illustrative concept images and are labelled as such. You may quote short passages with a link back to the source.

blocks.heading: Engagements are separate
paragraphs: Information on this site, including service descriptions and indicative prices, is general and is not an offer. Any work we do for you is governed by a separate written proposal or agreement, which takes priority over anything on this site.

blocks.heading: Third-party links
paragraphs: The site may link to other websites. We are not responsible for their content or how they handle your information.

blocks.heading: No warranty
paragraphs: We work to keep the site accurate and available, but it is provided “as is”, without warranties of any kind. Content may change or be removed without notice.

blocks.heading: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: To the fullest extent the law allows, DotGrey Digital is not liable for any indirect or consequential loss arising from your use of the site, or for any loss caused by relying on general information on it. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law.

blocks.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: How we handle personal information is explained in our Privacy Policy.

blocks.heading: Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of Bangladesh, and the courts of Dhaka have jurisdiction over any dispute about them, without affecting any mandatory rights you have under the law of the country where you live.

blocks.heading: Changes
paragraphs: We may update these terms from time to time. The date at the top shows when they last changed; continuing to use the site after a change means you accept the updated terms.
